claims.statement: UN on Nov 17 reported October 2026 civilian deaths 372 and injuries 1,981, 95% above the equivalent October 2025 count of killed and injured; events occurred during October.

UN says October attacks damaged Ukrainian electricity and heating infrastructure, causing electricity interruptions and, in some cities, water-supply disruptions and rolling power cuts; this is historic October physical damage, not new Nov17 throughput.
Reuters on Nov17 reports Indian state buyers awarded an approximately 2.75-million-tonne US LPG sourcing tender for deliveries in 2027, not cargoes delivered on Nov17.
Reuters says India obtained roughly 90% of its 2025 LPG imports from Middle Eastern suppliers; prospective US LPG tender seeks to diversify this pre-existing source concentration.
